_about: PROPOSAL (Sal, 2026-10-31), read by nothing yet. Camp-life and winter quests, same shape as data/items/starter_goals.json (see its _about for check kinds) with two additions: `needs_code` (true when a check kind or item chain does not exist yet: sea salt, new events worn_warmth, talked, moved_lit_night) and `after` may name goals from starter_goals.json. They teach the winter chain: render fat, smoke fish, dry berries, salt meat, keep a store, dress for the cold. The campfire pot, smoker and drying rack each have a build goal ahead of their first use (tools/goal_station_audit.py checks it); jerky and salted fish need sea salt (WATER_GATHER_SPEC.md).

goals.title: Light the night
goals.hint: Craft a Simple - Torch from a stick, a twine and a plant fibre, and carry it after dark.

goals.title: Hang a campfire pot
goals.hint: Fire 6 clay into a Clay - Pot at a lit campfire, then hold your hammer, press R, pick Campfire pot and click on the fire once its logs have burned down (3 sticks, 3 twine, the pot). Tallow and salt are made at it.

goals.title: Work by candlelight
goals.hint: Render animal fat into tallow at the campfire pot, then make candles (tallow and a plant fibre) to light your shelter.

goals.title: Build a smoker
goals.hint: Hold your hammer, press R and pick Smoker: 32 stones and 6 clay. Fish are smoked in it.

goals.title: Smoke a fish
goals.hint: Catch a fish and smoke it with a salt in the smoker. Salt is boiled from sea water at the campfire pot.

goals.title: Build a drying rack
goals.hint: Hold your hammer, press R and pick Drying rack: 8 sticks and 4 twine, with a knife in your pack. Berries and jerky dry on it.

goals.title: Dry berries for winter
goals.hint: Dry 3 berries at a time on the drying rack so they keep.

goals.title: Make jerky
goals.hint: Dry 2 raw meat with a salt on the drying rack. Salt is boiled from sea water at the campfire pot.

goals.title: Salt a fish
goals.hint: Cure a trout in salt at the campfire pot for the winter store.

goals.title: Fill your winter store
goals.hint: Hold 5 foods that keep: smoked fish, jerky, dried berries, salted fish, trail bread.

goals.title: Dress for the cold
goals.hint: Wear a full hide set or better before winter.

goals.title: Hear a story at the fire
goals.hint: Sit by the fire at night with Edda or Hob and listen.

goals.title: Cross the camp at night with a torch
goals.hint: Walk 100 m with a lit torch after dark without stumbling.
